title: Rampant
body:
**Rampant is a mod for BTA that changes hostile mob behavior and stats to make them more threatening.**

Mod may not work properly with mods that modify base game hostile mobs.

**What the mod changes (Spoilers Obviously):**


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

All affected mobs can spawn most hostile mobs on their head.

**Creepers**

- Are now as fast as the player.
- Lunges at the player when about to explode.
- Explodes when it detects a player behind a block.
- Now have a 1 in 20 chance to spawn charged.

**Skeletons**

- Are now as fast as the player.
- Fire twice as fast.
- Back up when their target gets close.
- Slightly increased projectile movement speed.


**Spiders**

- Are now as fast as the player.

**Slimes**

- Now splits into a minimum of 2 slimes and a maximum of 6.
- Slightly faster.
- Small slimes now deal damage.

**Zombies**

- Are now as fast as the player.
- Have double their normal health.
- Deal 7 damage instead of 5.
- When zombies hit their target when on fire they set their target on fire as well.


**Armored Zombies**

- Same changes as zombies

**Snowmen**

- Are now as fast as the player.
- Have double their normal health.
- Deal 7 damage instead of 5.
- Fire 3x faster.
- Snowballs deal 1 damage without gravel and deal 5 with gravel.
- Slightly increased range.
- Slightly increased projectile movement speed.


**Zombie Pigmen**

- Same changes as zombies
- Twice as fast

</details>
